purpose: Durable explicit Scene ID -> Topview task binding for current/known renders. Prevents remapping from prompt heuristics after normal scene edits.
authority: Telemetry mapping only. Google Drive video-prompts.md remains canonical for active scenes and slow membership.
rules: Use an existing verified task_id first; do not rediscover it from semantic similarity on every run.

For an unknown Topview task whose actual prompt is an exact or normalization-equivalent match to an existing active canonical scene, bind the new task to that existing Scene ID; do not create a duplicate Scene ID.
When such a newly bound existing-scene task is queued/running/init/processing, add that existing Scene ID to the canonical slow list while preserving its editorial/production state.

Semantic resemblance alone is not enough to discard a task: if it is neither an explicit retry/exact existing-scene match nor clearly a new scene, mark it ambiguous and notify instead of silently ignoring it.
Do not invalidate a binding merely because the canonical prompt text changes after a render was launched.
Change a binding only after explicit user decision, a newly launched replacement task, or clear proof that the task belongs to a different scene.
Topview success never implies approval and never removes canonical slow-lock.
